A '''Beskar spear''' was a type of [[Spear/Legends|spear]] made of [[Beskar/Legends|''beskar'']].<ref name="Cartel Market" /> Such weapons were used during the [[Third Galactic War]].<ref name="TOR_updates">{{TOR_updates|6.3}}</ref>

The [[Mandalorian shock trooper]] [[Larsi]] and other [[Hidden Chain]] lancers used beskar spears during the [[raid on Kessan's Landing]] during the [[Third Galactic War]].<ref name="TOR:CoC">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=daily|Chain of Command|Ord Mantell}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The beskar spear's appearance was created by [[Tanner Hartman]], a 3D artist working on the video game ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="ArtStation">{{ArtStation|username=htannerhartman|url=artwork/DAQozE|name=[[Tanner Hartman]]|text=Star Wars: The Old Republic - Ceremonial Beskar Spear}}</ref>
